sentence: This project builds algorithms that let intelligent robots see, think, and act in real-world tasks.
This project creates materials that were unexplored before and studies how they conduct heat, electricity, and magnetism.
This project studies how the movement of the uterus affects the cells in its inner lining.
This project uses mathematical analysis to solve complex, real-world problems through experimentation, conjecture, and rigorous verification.
This project brings together researchers on severe storms and on quantum computing to find where quantum computing may improve prediction of severe weather.
This project studies the biological, ecological, health, and social interactions of wildfire.
This project builds the support needed to turn fundamental research into technology startups.
This project studies what large language models can and cannot do, using ideas from mathematical logic.
This project builds tools that use atmospheric modeling and machine learning to predict wind-driven wildfires.
This project studies how context affects ethical judgments in engineering and tests whether language models can assess written responses.
This project builds a hybrid model that combines deep learning with prior knowledge to work with less data.
This project traces how nutritional information flows through a bumblebee colony.
This project designs metal alloys that lubricate themselves and resist wear at high temperatures.
This project searches for gravitational waves and uses machine learning to improve detectors and data analysis.
This project studies how fluids flowing through fractured rock react with minerals and change their own flow paths.
This project builds machine learning tools that tell apart patients with the same cancer type by using pathway knowledge.
This project tries to find out how DNA methylation first appears in the bodies of genes, using plants as model systems.
